'''Ta'rahg''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstiuted Sith Empire]]. He had a shop on the [[Promenade]], where he sold heavy armor.

==Behind the scenes==
Ta'rahg was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on Nar Shaddaa as an heavy armor vendor.
